description.en: Independent server monitoring with its own dashboard, authentication and data. Manage nodes and create Agent enrollment tokens in Senulun.
description.zh-CN: 独立服务器监控应用，自带面板、登录和数据存储。在 Senulun 中管理节点并创建探针配对令牌。

description.en: The exact HTTPS origin used in your browser, such as https://senulun.example.com. No subpath. Configure the matching access entry before signing in. Agents use their separately configured reachable HTTPS URL.
description.zh-CN: 浏览器实际访问的 HTTPS 地址，例如 https://senulun.example.com，不含子路径。登录前需配置匹配的访问入口。探针使用单独配置的、可访问的 HTTPS 地址。

description.en: Optional exact transport peer IP. Enable only when that proxy discards client-supplied X-Real-IP and overwrites it with the verified visitor IP. Empty disables forwarded visitor IPs.
description.zh-CN: 可选，填写反代连接 Senulun 时的准确来源 IP。仅在反代会丢弃客户端提供的 X-Real-IP 并用已核实的访客 IP 覆写时启用。留空不信任转发的访客 IP。

description.en: Outbound host monitoring. Supply a reachable Senulun HTTPS URL and an enrollment token created in Senulun, including for a service installed outside Vastora. No Docker required.
description.zh-CN: 主动连接监控主机的原生探针。填写可访问的 Senulun HTTPS 地址和在 Senulun 中创建的配对令牌，支持 Vastora 之外独立安装的监控主机，无需 Docker。

description.en: Optional ISO country code such as SG or US. A manual code takes priority over automatic discovery; omitted upgrade fields preserve existing settings.
description.zh-CN: 可选 ISO 国家或地区代码，例如 SG、US。手动代码优先于自动查询；升级时未填写的字段保留现有设置。

description.en: geojs (default), ipinfo, or disabled. The provider sees the public egress IP and Agent version, never Senulun credentials or metrics. Omit on upgrade to retain the current choice.
description.zh-CN: 填写 geojs（默认）、ipinfo 或 disabled。查询服务会看到出口公网 IP 和探针版本，不会收到 Senulun 凭据或监控指标。升级时留空保留当前选择。

description.en: An HTTPS URL ending in / that this host can reach without an interactive browser login, for example https://monitor.example.com/. The service can be installed independently of Vastora.
description.zh-CN: 本机无需浏览器交互登录即可访问、以 / 结尾的 HTTPS 地址，例如 https://monitor.example.com/。监控主机可以独立于 Vastora 安装。

description.en: The name shown for this host in Senulun.
description.zh-CN: 此主机在 Senulun 中显示的名称。

description.en: Optional group shown in Senulun. Leave empty for no group.
description.zh-CN: Senulun 中的节点分组，可留空。

description.en: Create a short-lived, single-use token in Senulun before installing this Agent. Only initial enrollment uses it; later upgrades keep the Agent's saved identity.
description.zh-CN: 安装前在 Senulun 中创建短期、一次性的配对令牌。仅首次配对使用；后续升级保留探针已保存的身份。

description.en: Telegram and feed collection with a notification dashboard. Enable collection after session setup.
description.zh-CN: Telegram 与资讯采集、通知及管理面板。完成会话迁移或登录后启用采集。

description.en: API ID from your Telegram application.
description.zh-CN: Telegram 应用的 API ID。

description.en: API hash stored as a private credential file.
description.zh-CN: Telegram API Hash，以私密凭据文件提供。

description.en: Telegram account phone number including country code.
description.zh-CN: Telegram 账号手机号，包含国际区号。

description.en: Unique dashboard password of at least eight characters.
description.zh-CN: 管理面板独立密码，至少八个字符。

description.en: Administrator login name.
description.zh-CN: 管理面板登录账号。

label.zh-CN: 启用采集（迁移或登录完成后开启）

description.en: Keep disabled until session migration or interactive login is complete. Never run two collectors on one session.
description.zh-CN: 完成会话迁移或交互登录后开启，同一会话不要同时运行两个采集器。

description.en: Enable for HTTPS access; disable only for local HTTP setup.
description.zh-CN: 使用 HTTPS 访问时开启；仅本地 HTTP 初始化时关闭。

description.en: Application-owned native Glivela and Xray services. Preserve node identity and import configuration before traffic cutover.
description.zh-CN: 应用自主管理的原生 Glivela 和 Xray 服务；切换流量前保留节点身份并导入配置。

label.zh-CN: 私网控制端 HTTPS 地址
